results.content: More than half of voters said they are worse off financially since the start of President Donald Trump’s second term in the latest poll released Sunday that found 64% disapprove of his handling of inflation and the cost of living. July 30Trump’s 33% approval rating in an AP-NORC poll released Thursday is eight points below where it was in July of his first term and is three points below Biden’s 36% approval rating in July 2022 (the AP-NORC poll of 1,165 U.S. adults was conducted July 23-27 and has a margin of error of 3.7).
